As an hourly paid, fully remote Rust Engineer for AI Data Training, you will review AI-generated Rust code and explanations or generate your own, evaluate the reasoning quality and step-by-step problem-solving, and provide expert feedback that helps models produce answers that are accurate, logical, and clearly explained. You will assess solutions for correctness, safety, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, or algorithmic reasoning; fact-check information; write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate idiomatic Rust patterns; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. Your work will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models while giving you the flexibility of impactful, detail-oriented remote contract work.
Important
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
1–2+ years of professional Rust development experience in backend, CLI, or systems-focused projects.
Strong understanding of Rust’s ownership, borrowing, and lifetime model, with the ability to reason clearly about aliasing and data races.
Solid software engineering experience in at least one of backend services, command-line tools, or systems programming using Rust.
Ability to evaluate safe, idiomatic Rust code, including appropriate use of traits, generics, pattern matching, and error handling.
Significant experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants while programming, combined with a disciplined approach to validating their output.
Excellent English writing skills, capable of producing precise, structured, and pedagogical technical explanations.
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
Previous experience with AI data training, code review at scale, or evaluation of AI-generated technical content is strongly preferred; Minimum C1 English proficiency and an extremely detail-oriented working style are required.
Highly preferred: experience with Tokio, Actix, Serde, and async Rust patterns in production or advanced side projects.
Preferred: competitive programming experience, contributions to Rust open-source ecosystems, and demonstrated ability to reason about performance, concurrency, and correctness in Rust code.

As a TypeScript Engineer, you will work remotely on an hourly paid basis reviewing AI-generated TypeScript code snippets, design proposals, and technical explanations, as well as generating your own high-quality content and reference solutions. You will evaluate step-by-step reasoning and problem-solving, checking solutions for correctness, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in logic, type modeling, or architectural thinking; fact-check technical information; craft clear explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct approaches; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on their reasoning quality and implementation soundness. This fully remote, hourly contractor position is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI data services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data to many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. In this role, your TypeScript expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models used by engineers and developers everywhere.
Important
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
Key Responsibilities
Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.
Your Profile
2+ years professional TypeScript experience.
Expertise in TypeScript features, including advanced type manipulation, generics, interfaces, and utility types.
Strong proficiency with a major frontend framework (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) or backend runtime (e.g., Node.js with Express or NestJS).
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), functional programming concepts, and common software design patterns.
Experience with Git and standard version control workflows (branching, merging, pull requests).
Familiarity with modern build tools (e.g., Webpack, Vite, Babel).
Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
Minimum C1 English proficiency (written and spoken), with strong ability to follow detailed technical guidelines.
Good to have: Merged PRs in TypeScript-based open-source projects.
Good to have: Competitive programming experience, experience reviewing typed API layers, DTOs, or schema-driven designs, and previous exposure to AI data training or annotation projects.

You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt, identify errors in methodology or conceptual understanding, fact-check information, write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct methods, and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. Preferred: contributions or merged PRs in JavaScript or TypeScript open-source projects, familiarity with bundlers and tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup), frontend–backend integration and Node.js runtime behavior, reviewing typed API layers, DTOs, or schema-driven designs, and experience evaluating frontend logic, async patterns, and state management.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Software Engineer (React) based in the United States.
As a Junior Software Engineer, you will help build and maintain user-friendly software applications that support organizations delivering essential healthcare and human services. You will focus on developing responsive, accessible React interfaces supported by .NET Core APIs and SQL Server databases. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to feature development, bug fixes, and continuous improvements across the full software stack. This role offers hands-on experience with modern frontend technologies, application architecture, and the software development lifecycle. You will receive guidance from experienced colleagues while progressively developing your technical expertise and taking ownership of more complex tasks. Your contributions will help improve the reliability and usability of technology that organizations depend on to serve their communities. You will thrive in a collaborative environment that values continuous learning, code quality, data security, and meaningful impact.
Accountabilities
Develop, test, and deliver well-defined features and bug fixes, with a primary focus on building responsive, accessible, and maintainable React user interfaces.
Implement reusable React components using hooks, component composition, and effective state and props management.
Integrate frontend applications with .NET Core APIs and SQL Server databases to ensure reliable communication and data flow across application layers.
Follow established development practices for code quality, testing, source control, and deployment workflows, seeking guidance from experienced engineers when needed.
Take responsibility for delivered features by identifying and resolving bugs, regressions, and usability issues, and addressing questions related to implementation and performance.
Participate in pull request reviews and technical discussions, provide constructive feedback, ask thoughtful questions, and communicate blockers early.
Apply established privacy and security practices when handling protected health information (PHI) and other sensitive customer data, using mocked or anonymized data during development and testing, including when working with AI-assisted tools.
Develop a strong understanding of the products, customers, and healthcare and human services sector while gradually taking greater ownership of feature design, implementation, and delivery.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and QA teams to deliver dependable software that meets user needs and maintains high standards of accessibility and reliability.
Requirements
1–3 years of software development experience acquired through professional employment, internships, academic work, or personal projects.
A bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience or certifications.
Working knowledge of React, including hooks, component composition, and state and props management.
Solid JavaScript skills and experience with HTML and CSS, including the development of responsive and accessible user interfaces.
Some experience with C# and familiarity with state management tools such as Redux or React Query.
A foundational understanding of full-stack application development and how frontend, backend, and database layers communicate.
Basic knowledge of data structures, algorithms, source code management tools such as Git, and deployment processes.
Demonstrated experience contributing to a software feature or project, with the ability to clearly explain individual responsibilities and contributions.
Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to code quality, usability, maintainability, and application reliability.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, including openness to constructive feedback, a willingness to ask questions, and the ability to seek support when facing challenges.
An understanding of the responsibilities involved in developing healthcare software and the importance of protecting PHI and other confidential customer information.
Nice To Have
Familiarity with Fluent UI or similar component libraries.
Experience with frontend testing tools such as Jest or React Testing Library.
Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or similar technologies.
Experience building or consuming REST APIs, particularly with .NET Core.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.
Benefits
Competitive annual salary: $75,000–$95,000, depending on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and other relevant factors.
Remote work flexibility: The opportunity to work remotely within the United States.
Unlimited paid time off: An unlimited PTO policy to support work-life balance.
Healthcare coverage: Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with employer matching.
Paid holidays: Dedicated time off for holidays throughout the year.
Volunteer time off: Paid time to participate in volunteer activities and support communities.
Paid parental leave: Support for employees and their families during important life events.
Remote work stipend: Financial support for remote working needs.
Professional development: Hands-on experience with React, JavaScript, .NET Core, SQL Server, frontend testing, accessibility, and secure software development.
Collaborative work environment: Opportunities to learn from experienced engineers and work closely with product and QA teams.
Meaningful work: The chance to contribute to software that helps healthcare and human services organizations deliver essential services to individuals and communities.
How Jobgether Works
We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Introduction
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
Your Role And Responsibilities
As an Application Developer specializing in SAP ABAP HANA, you will design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on the HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP). You will work on designing, developing, and re-engineering highly complex application components, integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
Develop Application Solutions: Design, develop, and support application solutions with a focus on HANA version of ABAP, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and platforms.
Integrate Software Packages: Integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms, leveraging knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture.
Re-engineer Application Components: Re-engineer highly complex application components to optimize performance, scalability, and reliability, utilizing ABAP Development Tools (ADT) and Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA.
Model Data using HANA Studio: Create data models using HANA Studio, adhering to best practices and ensuring data consistency and integrity.
Consume HANA Live Models: Consume HANA Live models to deliver real-time insights and analytics, leveraging knowledge of ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Exposure to SAP ABAP HANA: Experience working with HANA version of Advanced Business Application Programming (ABAP), including designing, developing, and supporting application solutions.
Knowledge of SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture: Familiarity with SAP HANA Technical Concept and Architecture, including data modeling using HANA Studio and ABAP Development Tools (ADT).
Experience with Data Modeling: Exposure to data modeling using HANA Studio, adhering to best practices and ensuring data consistency and integrity.
Understanding of Code Performance Rules: Familiarity with Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA, including ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Integration Experience: Experience integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects residing on multiple platforms.
Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
Working Knowledge of HANA Live: Familiarity with consuming HANA Live models to deliver real-time insights and analytics, leveraging knowledge of ADBC, Native SQL, and ABAP Core Data Services.
Exposure to Database Procedures: Understanding of database procedures, text search, and ALV on HANA, including data base procedures and HANA Live models consumption.
Familiarity with ABAP Core Data Services: Knowledge of ABAP Core Data Services, including data modeling and code performance optimization techniques.

Compute & Containerization: AWS ECS/EKS, Fargate, Lambda, Docker.

Job Title: Junior Software Developer
Type: Full-time
Location: Remote
Experience: 0–2 Years
Job Summary:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Software Developer to support the development, maintenance, and enhancement of software applications used in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences environments. The ideal candidate will contribute to application development, database management, software testing, and technical documentation while learning how digital solutions support laboratory operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical research, and quality management. This role is suitable for recent graduates with a background in life sciences or technology who are interested in applying software development skills to scientific and healthcare-related business processes.
Key Responsibilities:
Application Development: Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining software applications that support laboratory workflows, pharmaceutical operations, quality processes, and internal business requirements.
Programming and Coding: Write, review, and debug basic code using programming languages such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript under the guidance of experienced developers.
Database Management: Support database queries, data retrieval, record updates, and basic database maintenance using SQL and relational database concepts.
Software Testing: Develop and execute basic test cases, document test results, identify software defects, and assist with resolving reported issues.
Application Troubleshooting: Investigate application errors, review logs, reproduce technical issues, and escalate complex problems to senior development or support teams.
System Integration: Assist with integrating software applications with databases, reporting tools, laboratory information systems, or other approved enterprise platforms.
Life Sciences Workflow Support: Learn and document business workflows associated with laboratory testing, sample tracking, inventory management, manufacturing records, and quality documentation.
Technical Documentation: Prepare and maintain code documentation, application specifications, user guides, release notes, and technical support records.
Version Control: Use version-control tools such as Git to manage code changes, track development progress, and collaborate with other developers.
Computerized System Compliance: Support software testing and documentation activities for systems used in regulated environments, following applicable procedures and validation requirements.
Data Security: Follow established access controls, confidentiality requirements, and data protection practices when working with scientific, operational, or business information.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with business analysts, quality teams, laboratory personnel, validation specialists, and other developers to understand requirements and deliver reliable software solutions.
Required Skills:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Computational Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline .
Basic understanding of programming concepts, data structures, debugging, and software development fundamentals.
Familiarity with at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, C#, or JavaScript.
Basic knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data handling.
Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) concepts, including requirements, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Familiarity with software testing, defect tracking, and technical documentation.
Awareness of version-control tools such as Git is an advantage.
Basic understanding of pharmaceutical or life sciences workflows is preferred.
Awareness of Good Documentation Practices (GDP), data integrity, and computerized system validation (CSV) concepts is beneficial.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred: Academic projects, internships, or practical exposure to application development, database projects, bioinformatics tools, laboratory software, or digital solutions for pharmaceutical operations.

What You’ll Be Doing
Cadmus is seeking a Junior Full Stack Developer to join our Federal Operations Group. This role provides full-stack software development support to a file management application team, a high-performing Agile team responsible for delivering enterprise platforms and shared services that support multiple systems at a federal government health care organization. This solution includes file management activities including uploading and downloading files for a major federal healthcare organization. Other functionalities include large file transfers, file workflows, anti-virus scanning, PHI/PII scanning and other capabilities related to the secure transfer of files. It is anticipated that this file management application will undergo a complete redesign in the next few months.
Who We Are
Cadmus provides government, commercial, and other private organizations worldwide with technology-empowered advisory and implementation services. We help our clients achieve their goals and drive lasting, impactful change by leveraging transformative digital solutions and unparalleled expertise across domains.

XBOX is building a new kind of flywheel with games at the center.

The company announced XP this morning (a clever title)—a new division headed by Kayleen Walters focused on creating more on-ramps for fans to its beloved IP through film & television, consumer products, live events, and strategic partnerships.

Here are the four divisions:

* XBOX PICTURES: Bringing our worlds and characters to new audiences through film, television, and other forms of linear storytelling. 
* XBOX PRODUCTS: Creating products that are authentic to the fandom that allow fans to celebrate and express the franchises they love. 
* XBOX PLACES: Bringing communities together through live events, immersive experiences, attractions, broadcasts, and destinations. 
* XBOX PARTNERSHIPS: Working with creators, brands, and communities to develop new experiences, sponsorships, and brand partnerships.

The move—championed by Matthew Ball following an internal memo from Asha Sharma—is both elegant and strategic. It adopts the best strategies from Disney and Nintendo, both of whom understand that content is king. Where Disney’s flywheel was built strategically around film and television firs, Nintendo’s is game first.

With this move, XBOX is positioning itself to move beyond being a mere platform to owning its market position as both a publisher and steward of massive IP (from Minecraft to Halo and beyond).

I’m excited to see where this leads.
